test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain sum was invested on simple interest for a period of seven years. During the period of the sixth and the seventh years combined, the interest earned was Rs. 292 . If the maturity amount is Rs. 3,942, then what is the rate percentage of the interest?
solution: Given: Time = 7 years During the period of the sixth and the seventh years combined, the interest earned was Rs. 292. The maturity amount is Rs. 3,942, Concept used: Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100 where P = Principal amount
